name: Panang chicken curry (kaeng panang gai)
assumptions: Yield estimated from total main ingredients (200g chicken + 100g beans + 400ml coconut milk + rice) as typical for 2 adult servings of Thai curry with rice.
Preparation time summed from explicit steps (paste ~15 min pounding/processing, cooking ~10-15 min) plus estimated 15-20 min for ingredient prep and simmering; rounded conservatively.
All curry paste ingredients treated as used in full for the batch in this recipe.
Gluten-free assumes no hidden wheat in fish sauce or shrimp paste (common but not universal); no wheat-containing items listed.
Dairy-free confirmed as no milk, butter, or dairy items present.
Soy ambiguous due to possible fermented soy in shrimp paste or fish sauce but not explicitly listed.
No tree nuts; peanuts classified separately as peanuts allergen.
instructions:
step 1
First, make the curry paste. Use a pestle and mortar to pound together the dried and fresh chillies, shrimp paste, garlic, galangal, lemongrass, lime zest, white pepper, coriander, cumin, nutmeg and peanuts, plus 1 tsp salt. You should have a rough paste. Alternatively, add all the ingredients to a food processor along with 2-3 tbsp of coconut milk and pulse until you have a paste. Store in a lidded jar in the fridge. Will keep for up to two weeks.

step 2
Add 2-3 tbsp of the thick part of the coconut milk into a saucepan over a medium-high heat. When the coconut milk starts bubbling, add 1-2 tbsp of the curry paste and stir well for about 1 min, until fragrant.

step 3
Stir in the chicken and let it cook for about 3-4 mins until beginning to brown all over. Follow with the French beans and stir well.

step 4
Season with the fish sauce and sugar, then add the rest of coconut milk. Mix well, add half the makrut lime leaves and simmer for 3-5 mins until the chicken is cooked through. Taste and add more sugar or fish sauce if necessary – it should be salty and nutty, and the sweetness should come through. Add the Thai basil leaves, give it a quick mix and take off the heat. Serve with steamed jasmine rice, garnished with the sliced chilli and the rest of the makrut lime leaves.

ingredients.name: Coconut Milk
ingredients.assumptions: Canned full-fat coconut milk; using entire 400 ml can as listed, density ~1 g/ml.

ingredients.name: Panang Curry Paste
ingredients.assumptions: Homemade panang paste per step 1; ~30 g (1-2 tbsp) used in recipe, estimated from typical Thai curry paste density and ingredients.

ingredients.name: Chicken Breast
ingredients.assumptions: Raw boneless skinless chicken breast as listed; entire 200 g used.

ingredients.name: Green Beans
ingredients.assumptions: Raw trimmed green/French beans as listed; entire 100 g used.

ingredients.name: Fish Sauce
ingredients.assumptions: Typical fish sauce; 2-3 tbsp averaged to 36 g (density ~1.2 g/ml), sodium-heavy but low macros.

ingredients.name: Brown Sugar
ingredients.assumptions: Brown sugar; 1-2 tbsp averaged to 18 g.

ingredients.name: makrut lime leaves
ingredients.assumptions: 2 whole makrut lime leaves; negligible edible weight and nutrition.

ingredients.name: Basil Leaves
ingredients.assumptions: Thai/holy basil leaves; handful estimated at 15 g.

ingredients.name: Jasmine Rice
ingredients.assumptions: Cooked jasmine rice to serve; assumed 200 g boiled (typical single-serve portion from ~70 g dry) as 'boiled' is vague.

ingredients.name: Red Chilli
ingredients.assumptions: Fresh red chilli for garnish/sauce; 6 chillies estimated at 30 g total.

ingredients.name: Dried Red Chillies
ingredients.assumptions: Dried red chillies for paste; 4 chillies estimated at 12 g total.

ingredients.name: Shrimp Paste
ingredients.assumptions: Shrimp paste for curry paste; 1 tsp = 5 g.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.assumptions: Garlic cloves for paste; 4 cloves chopped ~12 g.

ingredients.name: Galangal
ingredients.assumptions: Galangal for paste; 1 tbsp ~6 g.

ingredients.name: Lemongrass
ingredients.assumptions: Lemongrass for paste; 1 tbsp ~6 g.

ingredients.name: Lime
ingredients.assumptions: Lime zest of 2 limes for paste; ~4 g total zest.

ingredients.name: Ground Nutmeg
ingredients.assumptions: Ground nutmeg for paste; 1 tsp ~2 g.

ingredients.name: Ground Coriander
ingredients.assumptions: Ground coriander for paste; 1 tsp ~2 g.

ingredients.name: Ground Cumin
ingredients.assumptions: Ground cumin for paste; 1 tsp ~2 g.

ingredients.name: Peanuts
ingredients.assumptions: Peanuts for paste; 2 tbsp ~20 g.
